source: Fontes rerum Austriacarum. 2. Abt. Diplomataria et acta
entries.summary:
Hz. Leopold [VI.] bestätigt, daß Abt H(einrich) von Zwettl per manum nostram curiam quandam in Mangolds cum iure urbano von Konrad von Rosenberg mit Zustimmung von dessen Sohn Konrad gekauft hat. Zeugen: Friedrich [II.] iunior dux , Hadmar von Kuenring, Heinrich von Kuenring, Albero von Falkenberg, Hugo von Rastenberg, Albero von Schwarzenau und dessen Sohn Pilgrim, Heinrich von Tribanswinchel , Rüdiger von Anschówe , Leopold pincerna , Konrad von Streitwiesen und dessen Bruder Eckbert von Steinekche , Rüdiger von Gruninbach und dessen Bruder Heinrich, Konrad von Mertinsdorf , Wichard von Arnstein, Offo von Pitten, Ulrich von Chinberch .

Siegel: S. des Ausst. an rotgelben Seidenschnüren.
entries.latin:
IN nomine sancte et indiuidue trinitatis. Levpoldus dei gratia dux Austrie et Styrie. Vniuersis christi fidelibus presentibus et futuris salutem imperpetuum. Quia inermium personarum tranquillitas in defensorum maxime consistit prouidentia, quia etiam uite claustralis conditio seculari conditioni est contraria et a negotiis secularibus sequestrata secularium uexationum perturbatione omnino deperiret, nisi accurata principum sollicitudine conseruaretur.

Unde vniuersis Christi fidelibus tam presentibus quam futuris notum esse volumus quod dominus R. abbas de Zwetil per manum nostram curiam quandam in Mangolds cum iure vrbano a domino Chvnrado de Rosinberch totam libere et precise comparauit filio suo Chvnrado huius curie uenditione approbante.

Ne igitur aliquis temeritatis occursus huius emptionis firmitatem irritare presumat presentem cartam sigilli nostri inpressione iussimus insigniri.

Acta autem sunt hec in Crems. Anno dominice incarnationis m° cc° xxviiij° xiiij° kal. Januarii, presentibus hijs quorum nomina presenti carte curauimus annotare, que sunt hec.

Fridericus junior dux. Hadmarus de Chvnnring. Heinricus de Chvnnringen. Albero de Valchenberch. Hugo de Rastenberch. Albero de Schwarzenowe et filius eius Pilgrimus. Heinricus de Tribanswinchel. Rudgerus de Anschovwe. Livpoldus pincerna. Chvnradus de Stritwesen et frater suus. Ekkenbertus de Steinekke. Rovdegerus de Grvninbach et frater suus Heinricus. Chvnradus de Mertindorf. Wichardus de Arnsteine. Otto de Pvten. Vlricus de Chinberch.
entries.english:
In the name of the holy and undivided Trinity. Leopold, by the grace of God duke of Austria and Styria, sends everlasting greetings to all Christian faithful, present and future. Since the peace of unarmed persons rests above all in the foresight of their protectors, and since the monastic life is contrary to the secular condition and withdrawn from worldly affairs, it would perish altogether through the disturbances of worldly harassment unless preserved by the careful concern of princes.

Therefore, we wish it to be known to all Christian faithful, present and future, that Lord R., abbot of Zwettl, through our hand, purchased a certain curia in Mangolds with urban rights from Lord Konrad of Rosenberg, freely and outright, with Konrad, his son, approving the sale of this curia.

Lest anyone presume through a rash act to invalidate the validity of this purchase, we have ordered this present charter to be marked with the impression of our seal.

This was done at Krems in the year of the Lord’s Incarnation 1229, on the fourteenth day before the Kalends of January [19 December], in the presence of those whose names we have taken care to record in this charter. They are: Friedrich, the younger duke; Hadmar of Kuenring; Heinrich of Kuenring; Albero of Falkenberg; Hugo of Rastenberg; Albero of Schwarzenau and his son Pilgrim; Heinrich of Tribanswinchel; Rudgerus of Anschouwe; Livpoldus the cupbearer; Chvnradus of Stritwesen and his brother; Ekkenbertus of Steinekke; Rovdegerus of Gruninbach and his brother Heinrich; Chvnradus of Mertindorf; Wichardus of Arnsteine; Otto of Pvten; and Vlricus of Chinberch.
